my-browser.sheet:
my-browser tools — call exactly like this inside execute: tools["my-browser"].<name>({...}); no other names or fields exist:
This is the user's own browser with their open tabs and logins: work in a new tab you open, close only that tab when done, and never navigate, reload or close the user's tabs.
- browser_click({ element?: str, target: str, doubleClick?: bool, button?: "left"|"right"|"middle", modifiers?: [] })  // Perform click on a web page
- browser_close({  })  // Close the page
- browser_drag({ startElement?: str, startTarget: str, endElement?: str, endTarget: str })  // Perform drag and drop between two elements
- browser_evaluate({ element?: str, target?: str, function: str, filename?: str })  // Evaluate JavaScript expression on page or element  [function = () => { /* code */ } or (element) => { /* code */ } when element is provided]
- browser_file_upload({ paths?: [] })  // Upload one or multiple files
- browser_fill_form({ fields: [] })  // Fill multiple form fields
- browser_find({ text?: str, regex?: str, filename?: str })  // Search the accessibility snapshot of the current page for text or a regular expression
- browser_handle_dialog({ accept: bool, promptText?: str })  // Handle a dialog
- browser_hover({ element?: str, target: str })  // Hover over element on page
- browser_mouse_click_xy({ x: num, y: num, button?: "left"|"right"|"middle", clickCount?: num, delay?: num })  // Click mouse button at a given position
- browser_mouse_drag_xy({ startX: num, startY: num, endX: num, endY: num })  // Drag left mouse button to a given position
- browser_navigate({ url: str })  // Navigate to a URL
- browser_navigate_back({  })  // Go back to the previous page in the history
- browser_press_key({ key: str })  // Press a key on the keyboard
- browser_run_code_unsafe({ code?: str, filename?: str })  // Run a Playwright code snippet  [code = `async (page) => { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click(); return await page.title(); }`]
- browser_select_option({ element?: str, target: str, values: [] })  // Select an option in a dropdown
- browser_snapshot({ target?: str, filename?: str, depth?: num, boxes?: bool })  // Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page, this is better than screenshot
- browser_tabs({ action: "list"|"new"|"close"|"select", index?: num, url?: str })  // List, create, close, or select a browser tab.
- browser_take_screenshot({ element?: str, target?: str, type?: "png"|"jpeg"|"webp", filename?: str, fullPage?: bool, scale: "css"|"device" })  // Take a screenshot of the current page
- browser_type({ element?: str, target: str, text: str, submit?: bool, slowly?: bool })  // Type text into editable element
- browser_wait_for({ time?: num, text?: str, textGone?: str })  // Wait for text to appear or disappear or a specified time to pass
One call does a whole open-and-read task, waiting for the content — prefer this over one action per step (adapt the URL and the selector):
const s = tools["my-browser"];
await s.browser_tabs({ action: "new", url: "https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=lord+of+the+mysteries" }); // your own new tab — never navigate the user's tabs
let r;
// pages often draw their content after loading: try for up to 15 s (2026-11-18: a freshly
// started Firefox drew YouTube's results only after several seconds)
for (const until = Date.now() + 15000; Date.now() < until; ) {
  await s.browser_snapshot({}); // lets the page settle
  r = await s.browser_evaluate({ function: "() => { const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('a#video-title')].slice(0, 3).map(a => ({ title: a.textContent.trim(), url: a.href })); return JSON.stringify({ found: items.length, items }); }" });
  const t = JSON.stringify(r);
  if (/found\\*":\s*[1-9]/.test(t) || /error/i.test(t)) break; // data, or an error to read
  await s.browser_wait_for({ time: 1 });
}
await s.browser_tabs({ action: "close" }); // closes the current tab = the one you opened
return r;

One call does a whole open-and-read task, waiting for the content — prefer this over one action per step (adapt the URL and the selector):
const s = tools["my-firefox"];
const opened = String(await s.new_page({ url: "https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=lord+of+the+mysteries" })); // "new page [N] → url" — your own tab
const idx = Number(opened.match(/\[(\d+)\]/)?.[1]);
let r;
// pages often draw their content after loading: try for up to 15 s (2026-11-18: a freshly
// started Firefox drew YouTube's results only after several seconds)
for (const until = Date.now() + 15000; Date.now() < until; ) {
  await s.take_snapshot({}); // lets the page settle
  r = await s.evaluate_script({ function: "() => { const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('a#video-title')].slice(0, 3).map(a => ({ title: a.textContent.trim(), url: a.href })); return JSON.stringify({ found: items.length, items }); }" });
  const t = JSON.stringify(r);
  if (/found\\*":\s*[1-9]/.test(t) || /error/i.test(t)) break; // data, or an error to read
  const p = Date.now() + 800; while (Date.now() < p) {}
}
if (Number.isInteger(idx)) await s.close_page({ pageIdx: idx }); // close only the tab you opened
return r;

chrome-devtools.sheet:
chrome-devtools tools — call exactly like this inside execute: tools["chrome-devtools"].<name>({...}); no other names or fields exist:
- click({ pageId: num, uid: str, dblClick?: bool, includeSnapshot?: bool })  // Clicks on the provided element
- close_page({ pageId: num })  // Closes the page by its index
- drag({ pageId: num, from_uid: str, to_uid: str, includeSnapshot?: bool })  // Drag an element onto another element
- evaluate_script({ pageId: num, function?: str, sourcePath?: str, format?: "function"|"script", args?: [], filePath?: str, dialogAction?: str, waitForStableDom?: bool })  // Evaluate JavaScript inside the target page  [function = `() => document.title`]
- fill({ pageId: num, uid: str, value: str, includeSnapshot?: bool })  // Type text into an input, text area or select an option from a <select> element.
- fill_form({ pageId: num, elements: [], includeSnapshot?: bool })  // Fill out multiple form elements (inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios) at once
- handle_dialog({ pageId: num, action: "accept"|"dismiss", promptText?: str })  // If a browser dialog was opened, use this command to handle it
- hover({ pageId: num, uid: str, includeSnapshot?: bool })  // Hover over the provided element
- list_pages({  })  // Get a list of pages open in the browser.
- navigate_page({ pageId: num, type?: "url"|"back"|"forward"|"reload", url?: str, ignoreCache?: bool, handleBeforeUnload?: "accept"|"dismiss", initScript?: str, timeout?: int })  // Go to a URL, or back, forward, or reload
- new_page({ url: str, background?: bool, isolatedContext?: str, timeout?: int })  // Open a new tab and load a URL
- press_key({ pageId: num, key: str, includeSnapshot?: bool })  // Press a key or key combination
- select_page({ pageId: num, bringToFront?: bool })  // Select a page as a context for future tool calls.
- take_heapsnapshot({ pageId: num, filePath: str })  // Capture a heap snapshot of the target page
- take_screenshot({ pageId: num, format?: "png"|"jpeg"|"webp", quality?: num, uid?: str, fullPage?: bool, filePath?: str })  // Take a screenshot of the page or element.
- take_snapshot({ pageId: num, verbose?: bool, filePath?: str })  // Take a text snapshot of the target page based on the a11y tree
- type_text({ pageId: num, text: str, submitKey?: str })  // Type text using keyboard into a previously focused input
- upload_file({ pageId: num, uid: str, filePaths: [], includeSnapshot?: bool })  // Upload a file through a provided element.
- wait_for({ pageId: num, text: [], timeout?: int })  // Wait for the specified text to appear on the selected page.
